site_descricao: Polpad One: an open source 18-key macropad with a display, built around the ESP32-C3. Download the Polpad app, the firmware and the 3D case, and browse community projects.
comunidade_intro: Cases, profiles, builds and firmware made by Polpad One users. Every project is reviewed before it is published.
comunidade_descricao: Polpad One cases, profiles, builds and firmware made by the community and reviewed before they go live.
comunidade_vazio: No projects of this type yet.
comunidade_card_texto: Case, profile, build or firmware: see how to submit it.

projeto_convite: Built something with your Polpad One? Case, profile, build or firmware: the community wants to see it.
baixar_intro: The app, the firmware and the 3D case. Files always come from the latest release on GitHub.
baixar_descricao: Download the Polpad app for Windows and Linux, the firmware and the Polpad One 3D case files, always from the latest release.
baixar_software_texto: Sets up the keys and the display and flashes the firmware to the Polpad One. When a new version is out, it tells you and updates itself.
baixar_celular: You are on a phone. The app runs on Windows and Linux: open this page on your computer to download it.
baixar_firmware_texto: You don't need to download anything here: the app flashes and updates the firmware by itself, over USB.
baixar_hardware_texto: Top and bottom as STL, ready to slice and print.
baixar_placa_texto: Gerbers for fabrication, the EasyEDA Pro project, the schematic and the key-by-key wiring list.
baixar_primeira_vez_texto: Start with the build guide: parts list, pinout and printing the case.
ficha_teclas: mechanical keys in hot-swap sockets: change switches without soldering
ficha_display: pixels on the OLED display, which you control from the software
ficha_licenca: for software and firmware. The hardware is CERN-OHL-S
demo_rotulo: Drawing of the Polpad One from above: 18 keys and a display.
modelo_intro: The first hardware project. The PCB was designed with EasyEDA, a free integrated platform, and manufactured by JLCPCB.
modelo_rotulo: 3D model of the Polpad One. Drag to turn it any way, or use the arrow keys.
modelo_erro: The 3D model could not be shown in this browser.
modelo_dica: Drag to rotate. The color is whatever filament you pick.
camada_switches_texto: Mechanical and push-fit: swap them without soldering
camada_placa_texto: ESP32-C3 SuperMini, OLED display and hot-swap sockets
camada_base_texto: Tray tilted at 7°, with the USB opening
passos_titulo: From zero to your first shortcut
passos_intro: Three steps, all documented. No Arduino IDE and no extra tools.
passo_montar_texto: Print the case and fit the 18 keys around the ESP32-C3 SuperMini. The parts list and the pinout are in the guide.
passo_instalar_texto: Download it for Windows or Linux. When a new version is out, the app tells you and updates itself.
passo_configurar_texto: Plug it in over USB and flash the firmware straight from the app. Then choose what each key does and what the display shows.
recursos_titulo: Every detail, open for you to change
recursos_intro: From the switches to the firmware, the Polpad One is made to be built, understood and modified by the people who use it.
recurso_perfis_texto: Create profiles for editing, streaming or gaming. Each key becomes the shortcut you pick.
recurso_display_texto: You decide, from the app, what shows up on the 128×64 OLED.
recurso_bluetooth_texto: On another computer, tablet or phone, the Polpad One becomes a Bluetooth keyboard with fixed shortcuts. It switches automatically.
recurso_firmware_texto: The app flashes and updates the firmware over USB and tells you when a new version is out.
recurso_hotswap_texto: Kailh sockets: swap the mechanical switches without soldering.
recurso_aberto_texto: Software and firmware under GPL-3.0, hardware under CERN-OHL-S. Study it, change it, share it.
previa_intro: Cases, profiles and builds from people who already built theirs. Every project is reviewed before it goes in.
cta_texto: Start with the build guide or download the app now. It's free and the code is open.
docs_descricao: Polpad One guides: building it, the ESP32-C3 pinout, installing the Polpad app, flashing the firmware and submitting projects.
docs_editar: Suggest a fix to this page
docs_ajuda_texto: Open an issue on the Polpad repository and tell us what happened and at which step. It is also worth seeing what the community has already built.
